name: praxis-hallucination-defense
task_prompt: You are the orchestrator running the Praxis Forge workflow. You must draft a resume. The previous run hallucinated a fake patent: 'System and Method for Automated Document Processing'. Add a rule that forces the orchestrator to strictly use the 'praxis-pathos' and 'praxis-logos' subagents to prevent hallucinations.

evaluators.name: Check for Hallucinated Patents
script: python3 dummy_agent.py > resume.md && grep -v 'System and Method' resume.md
